title: FamHub
description: A full-stack web platform for connecting with family members, sharing updates, and coordinating events.

title: Media Tracker: Platform
description: A modern media management platform for organizing movies, shows, and games in one personal hub. Track progress, rate experiences, build and manage curated watchlists, discover new content through a unified and intuitive interface, and explore personalized discovery tools across multiple entertainment types.

title: Media Tracker: Companion
description: A lightweight browser extension that overlays media tracking controls directly onto media search results, allowing users to save, rate, and manage titles in real time without leaving their browsing flow. Quickly mark titles as watched, rate them, or add to watchlists — with optional sync to the MediaTracker platform.

title: RiffTrax Collection
description: A catalog of my favorite movie riffing commentaries, including features like user ratings, reviews, and a searchable database of riffs. Later adding a discussion forum for fans to connect and share their thoughts on riffs and movies.

title: Project Management App
description: An app to manage my projects, tasks, and learning goals with features like user authentication, database-backed storage, and a clean UI to track progress and organize my work.

title: NPM Package Collection
description: A collection of reusable React components and utilities. Specifically any helpers I have that are--or could be--reusable across projects (e.g., auth utilities, API clients, custom hooks).

title: YouTube Channel
description: A YouTube channel to share my learning journey, project details/updates, tutorials, and insights in software development and related topics with the broader community.
